rows.what_the_ink_shows: Inspected the full scan and enlarged, contrast-raised crops crops/62_scan017_L797_affine_group.png and crops/62_scan017_L797_matrices.png. The sentence reads Ce n'est autre que le groupe affine à 1 variable, with the group phrase underlined. The preceding left matrix visibly has diagonal entries 1, lambda^2, lambda^3 and an alpha in the upper middle entry; the right-hand parametrization is followed by u^3-v^2=0. These written features match the original LaTeX at the supplied row location.
rows.note: Retain the written identification with the groupe affine à 1 variable. The supplied correction proposes instead G_a semidirect G_m with weight 2, acting by y -> lambda^2 y + alpha and x -> lambda^3 x, and describes its map to the affine group of the y-line as a double cover with kernel {+1,-1}, the symmetry. That is a mathematical refinement of the author's identification, not an ink correction. The proposed isomorphism invariant and the cited Pro note A31 were not independently checked in this visual review.
